# Guide to International ETFs: Building Your Passport Portfolio. Image 1: TD Asset Management. *   About Us and CapabilitiesGo Back About Us and Capabilities. *   About Our People and Capabilities. # Guide to International ETFs: Building Your "Passport Portfolio" | The ETF Experience. **International ETFs are a simple way to invest in markets outside your home country.** If you're trying to pick out an international ETF, though, you'll notice it's not quite the same as planning your summer vacation. Should you invest in international, global, or emerging markets? Each option offers a different level of exposure to countries, regions and economies. **In this episode, investors of all levels will learn how to use international ETFs to diversify their portfolio, reduce risk, and gain access to growth opportunities around the world.**. *   What is the difference between international markets, global markets, and emerging markets?**(2:41)**. *   How do you invest in international ETFs?**(4:41)**. ## What countries are considered emerging markets?
